name: @subham/database
description: Database schema, migrations, seeders, and Prisma client for Subham Fabrics MES

scripts.generate: node -e "if(!process.env.DATABASE_URL) ; try { require('child_process').execSync('npx prisma generate', {stdio:'inherit', env:process.env}); } catch(e) { console.warn('Using existing client:', e.message); }"
scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); try { fs.cpSync('src/generated', 'dist/generated', {recursive:true}); } catch(e) {}"
